subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice delivery channel & sample template questions
messages:
From: John Carter <john.carter@acmesupplies.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding: invoice submission for Redwood POs

Hi Karthik / Monica,

Thanks for the welcome call yesterday. We're starting the paperwork for Redwood and have a couple of quick questions to ensure our billing team sends invoices in a format that will ingest cleanly: 

- Does Redwood require invoices to go through the vendor portal for first 90 days (or permanently)?
- If we use email as a fallback, what subject/file name conventions do you need so AP can auto-route?
- Can one invoice cover multiple Redwood POs? If so, any required PO-level line mappings?
- Please share a minimal CSV header or PDF sample you prefer. We attached a rough sample invoice for your reference (Acme_Invoice_SAMPLE.pdf).

We also have VAT questions for EU shipments (we'll need remit-to and tax fields). Happy to hop on a short call if that's easier.

Thanks,
John Carter
Billing Manager
Acme Supplies
Attachment: Acme_Invoice_SAMPLE.pdf (stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: John Carter <john.carter@acmesupplies.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding: invoice submission for Redwood POs

Hi John — great to meet you on the call. Quick answers below and a request for one clarification:

1) Channel preference: We prefer the vendor portal for onboarding and ongoing invoices because it gives fastest acknowledgements and better PO matching. However, email is an allowed fallback for the first 30 days while you finish portal enrollment. After onboarding we expect portal-only for new invoices unless we agree an exception.

2) Email fallback conventions: If you must email, set the subject to: Redwood Invoice [PO#12345] and filename to: Redwood_INV_<PO#>_<invoice-date>.pdf or .csv. Put all PO numbers in the subject when one invoice covers multiple POs (comma-separated).

3) Multi-PO invoices: Allowed. Please include a line-level CSV column named "po_number" or stamp each PDF line with PO#. For PDFs we need a cover page listing POs + total per PO, otherwise AP will split the invoice which delays payment.

4) Sample template: Attached our vendor onboarding form (vendor-onboard-form-v2.pdf) which includes a minimal CSV header example. Use columns: invoice_number, invoice_date, line_description, quantity, unit_price, tax_amount, po_number, remit_to_entity.

5) VAT / international: Include tax_id and country fields on the invoice. If VAT is zero-rated, add the clause "VAT exempt — reverse charge" on the cover page and attach a certificate where applicable.

Can you confirm if Acme intends to submit as PDF or CSV during the rollout? If you prefer, we can provision a test account in the portal and ingest a sample CSV to validate mapping.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Manager, Supplier Onboarding
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: John Carter <john.carter@acmesupplies.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding: invoice submission for Redwood POs

Hi John — adding AP/ops context so expectations are crystal clear from an intake and SLA perspective. A few operational constraints and mitigation notes: 

- Acknowledgement SLA: portal uploads = immediate ack; email fallback = ack within 72 business hours. If you need SLA exceptions for early customers, please flag during activation.
- Filename & subject tokens: follow Karthik's convention exactly. Subject token parsing is case-insensitive but commas separate POs. Example subject: "Redwood Invoice [PO#12345,PO#12346]"
- Attachments: PDFs are accepted; CSV preferred for automated ingestion. If sending PDFs, please include a single cover page with PO mapping to avoid manual rework.
- Security & PII: Do not include customer personal data (SSNs, full-card numbers) in invoice line descriptions. If you need to send sensitive tax docs, use the secure portal link below instead of email.

Portal guide: https://redwood.app/portal-guide/vendor-onboarding (use this to request a test account).
HubSpot onboarding record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

If you want, Karthik and I can run a one-time sample ingest (you send CSV to our sandbox) and we'll send a mapping report.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Vendor Activation Ops
Redwood Inference

From: John Carter <john.carter@acmesupplies.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding: invoice submission for Redwood POs

Thanks Vanessa (and Karthik). We'll plan to: 

- Complete the vendor onboarding form you attached and request portal access (prefer portal).
- Send a CSV sample to the sandbox for mapping (when you provision it) — CSV preferred.
- For the short rollout we'll use a single PDF per invoice with a cover page listing PO totals until the portal is active.

Two quick clarifications: 
1) For multi-PO invoices, is Redwood OK with a single invoice_number and lines annotated with po_number?
2) Our EU shipments will include VAT — do you need us to submit both gross and net columns in the CSV or is tax_amount sufficient?

Appreciate the help. I'll attach our completed onboarding form when ready.

John Carter
Billing Manager, Acme Supplies
Attachment: completed_onboard_form.pdf (will follow)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>
To: John Carter <john.carter@acmesupplies.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, AP Team <ap-team@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding: invoice submission for Redwood POs

John — thanks, and welcome again. Confirming the mutual action plan and next steps so we can close activation by Oct 9: 

Action items: 
- Acme: complete and return vendor-onboard-form-v2.pdf + sample CSV (by Oct 4).
- Redwood (Karthik/Vanessa): provision portal test account + ingest sample (by Oct 6).
- AP (Monica): validate mapping report and confirm go-live rules for multi-PO splitting (by Oct 8).

Answers to your clarifications: 
1) Yes — single invoice_number is fine as long as every line includes the po_number column. That allows automated allocation.
2) For EU VAT, tax_amount is sufficient, but please include a separate column tax_rate (percentage) and tax_id (VAT reg number). Gross/net columns are optional but helpful.

If you run into any portal access issues, copy ap-team@redwood.inference.com and we'll escalate immediately. Looking forward to the sample CSV.

Best,
Monica Patel
AP Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
